mapper.select: SELECT id, warranty_code, initiation_id, contract_id, project_type, project_level, start_date, end_date, duration_months, notice_days, notice_sent, notice_sent_at, status, terminated_at, terminated_reason, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_warranty WHERE warranty_code = #{code} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT id, warranty_code, initiation_id, contract_id, project_type, project_level, start_date, end_date, duration_months, notice_days, notice_sent, notice_sent_at, status, terminated_at, terminated_reason, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_warranty WHERE initiation_id = #{initiationId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY start_date DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, warranty_code, initiation_id, contract_id, project_type, project_level, start_date, end_date, duration_months, notice_days, notice_sent, notice_sent_at, status, terminated_at, terminated_reason, contact_name, contact_phone, remark, tenant_id, provider_trace_id, created_by, created_at, updated_by, updated_at, deleted FROM pmis_warranty WHERE end_date <= #{until} AND status IN ('ACTIVE', 'EXPIRING_SOON') AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY end_date
